Why choose MES?

Medical Electronic Systems (MES) is the global leader in semen analysis solutions, serving every major testing environment including Clinics, Fertility Centers, Reference Laboratories, Mail-In Programs, and At-Home Testing.

 

Our comprehensive portfolio of CE and FDA-cleared Sperm Quality Analyzers (SQA), laboratory accessories, and consumer testing solutions like YO Home Sperm Test and MaleMan are designed to address fertility and infertility testing challenges worldwide.
